title: J’ai enfin trouvé l’application qui fonctionne avec moi!!
author: actias7

title: The best productivity app
body:
I truly cannot live without Sunsama. It incorporates the perfect amount of AI, whilst still letting the user have the majority of the control to customize things to their liking.

Lots of neat features such as focus mode, timer widget, and integrations with many other apps.

I have seen lots of development over the last 4 years. Amazing customer support as well!
author: cameojkd

title: The best productivity app. Simplicity, focus. Can’t live without Sunsama.
body:
The best productivity app of the many many I’ve tried and researched. Simplicity, focus, 2 way connections to all other list and project management tools. Can’t live without Sunsama. 

Tablet app it’s still in development, works great in browser on iPad or phone. Mobile app is simple but does what’s needed on the go.
author: Nfufiemwosmu

title: Seize the day and week
body:
Love the fact that there is now the ability to add tasks via Siri and also to align a tasks to objective in the mobile app. Start using it. Best money I spend each month. 

I also love the meditations emails
